instruction: Clean the movie titles from column B by removing extra whitespace and capitalizing the first letter of each word. Write the cleaned titles to column C. Then, find the longest cleaned title and highlight it with a yellow background.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the longest cleaned title and highlighting it. Verified with Python: the longest title is 'Eternal Sunshine Of The Mindless Spot' (37 chars) at row 11, cell C11. Agent must highlight this cell with yellow background.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if cell C11 is highlighted (yellow or any color), 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: INCOMPLETE COVERAGE: Evaluator only checks if cell C11 is highlighted (step 4 of instruction), but does NOT verify steps 1-3: (1) cleaning titles in column B, (2) writing cleaned titles to column C, (3) whether C11 actually contains the longest cleaned title
SEMANTIC VERIFICATION FAILURE: An agent could highlight C11 without cleaning any data, or clean data incorrectly, or highlight the wrong cell arbitrarily, and still pass with 1.0 score

INCORRECT EXPECTED VALUE LOGIC: The evaluator assumes C11 is the correct cell but doesn't verify this claim. It should check that C11 contains the longest cleaned title, not just that it's highlighted

COLOR MATCHING ISSUE: Instruction specifies 'yellow background' but strict_color_match=false means ANY fill color passes, not just yellow. Should enable strict matching or at least verify yellow-ish colors
MISSING DATA VALIDATION: No verification that column C contains cleaned versions of column B (whitespace removed, title case applied)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to read all values from column C and verify they are cleaned versions of column B (whitespace removed, title case)
Add getter to compute the length of each cleaned title and verify C11 contains the longest one
Add metric to compare column C values against expected cleaned values, not just highlighting
Enable strict_color_match=true and set expected_color to yellow (FFFF00) to match instruction requirement
Use multi-step evaluation with partial credit: 0.25 for cleaning, 0.25 for writing to column C, 0.25 for finding longest, 0.25 for highlighting correct cell with yellow
